WITH params AS (SELECT 15 AS campaign_id),
campaign AS (SELECT c.campaign_id, c.start_date, c.end_date + 7 AS window_end FROM dim_campaign c JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = c.campaign_id),
targeted AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = e.campaign_id),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT h.member_id FROM campaign_holdout h JOIN params ON params.campaign_id = h.campaign_id),
members AS (SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout),
web_dispatch AS (SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')),
member_sales AS (
 SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
 FROM fact_sales_line f
 JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
 JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
 LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
 CROSS JOIN campaign
 WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
   AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.window_end
 GROUP BY 1),
by_group AS (SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT member_group, members, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 2) FROM by_group
UNION ALL SELECT 'both', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted JOIN holdout USING (member_id)), NULL

WITH d AS (SELECT sale_date, COUNT(*) n, SUM(net_amount) net FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id<900 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-22' AND DATE '2025-12-09' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (SELECT business_date, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) nsbr, SUM(receipts) rc FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-22' AND DATE '2025-12-09' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.sale_date, d.n, d.net, r.nsbr, r.rc FROM d FULL JOIN r ON r.business_date=d.sale_date ORDER BY 1

WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign c
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND (s.store_id <> 900 OR w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL)
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 15 AS campaign_id, 'Black Week 2025' AS campaign_name,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END),2) AS avg_spend_targeted,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END),2) AS avg_spend_holdout,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END),2) AS uplift_eur,
  MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN members END) AS n_targeted,
  MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN members END) AS n_holdout
FROM by_group
